items.prompt: What joined result follows Q=2 and weights [0,1,1,1]?

options.why: The zero-weight bucket has zero quota and cannot receive this leftover.
Equal positive remainders prefer earlier positive buckets, not later ones.
The first two positive-weight buckets win the equal remainder ties.
Each bucket receives at most one unit above its floor quota.

items.explanation: The first two positive-weight buckets win the equal remainder ties.
